name: Cia de Talentos
notes: Homepage is Portuguese. The language control shows only PT, linking to /pt/, so no other languages were confirmed. No HQ, pricing, API or partner program was stated on the pages read. Employer page describes services, no prices stated. Only Portuguese was seen in the language switch.
